latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of thesis-revision-editor skill.

- Enables review, revision, and saving of theses, dissertations, proposals, or chapters based on user-supplied text or file.
- Produces a prioritized modification list, applies edits to improve academic quality, structure, logic, and clarity, and preserves core research content.
- Saves revised versions alongside originals and provides clear change explanations and revision summaries.
- Adheres to a rigorous workflow and chapter-specific academic standards for all revisions.
- Ensures factual and scholarly integrity by not inventing data, citations, or altering foundational research elements.
